name: SkyN3t Golden Design Suite v1
description: Five design-distinctiveness contracts: each brief demands a specific, non-default aesthetic so generic output (the AI-default indigo-gradient/Inter/glassmorphism look) is visible as a failure. Compare runs by score AND by the advisory AI-look warnings recorded in manifest.extra.web_polish.warnings. Run: skyn3t bench golden run --suite skyn3t/benchmarks/golden-design-v1.json. The brutalist case floors intent at 70, not 80: style-direction words ('grotesque', 'anti-corporate', '2px borders') legitimately never appear as page copy on a CORRECT delivery — verified against a real build whose site was unmistakably on-brief.

cases.brief: Build a brutalist web zine homepage called GRIDLOCK: stark black-and-white palette, oversized grotesque headlines, hard 2px borders, zero rounded corners, visible grid lines, and deliberately anti-corporate attitude. Include a masthead, three article teasers with real headlines, and a manifesto section.

Build a warm editorial website for a small artisan bakery: cream and terracotta palette, serif display typography, generous whitespace, a story section about the founder, a daily menu with real items and prices, and market-day hours.

Build a minimal Swiss international-style analytics dashboard: strict grid discipline, black type on white with a single red accent, tabular numerals, no decorative imagery, and charts rendered as precise geometric SVG. Include four metric panels and one time-series chart with real sample data.
Build an art-deco boutique hotel site: deep emerald and brass palette, geometric deco borders, elegant letterspaced serif headings, a room showcase with nightly rates, and a reservation enquiry form.

Build a playful Y2K-era personal portfolio for a digital artist: chrome-look headings, pastel sticker badges, a scrolling marquee ticker, a guestbook section, and a gallery grid of six works with titles.
